> network), STOP and do not confirm.

> PRE-CHECK BEFORE DEPLOY (do this first):
> - Top up BNB to ~0.003 total if possible (now 0.0015568). Deploy+seed+test
>   costs ≈ 0.000163 BNB at 0.05 gwei, leaving ≈ 0.00139 — below Rija's
>   0.0015 floor. Deploy fits without a top-up, but the floor will be
>   breached. Recommended top-up: ~0.0015 BNB.
> - Re-check live gas: https://bscscan.com/gastracker — if gas is far above

## Step 0 — What you deploy

| Item | Value (copy character by character) |
|---|---|
| Contract | `AgentRadar` from `contracts/AgentRadar.sol` (single file, no imports) |
| Registry (constructor arg 1) | `0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F` |
| Owner (constructor arg 2) | `0x7917A535D0Cb92dC3c16c8d3bcFC4E0F2bDBB91A` (your Binance Agentic Wallet) |
| Compiler | Solidity **0.8.38**, optimizer **ON**, runs **200**, license **MIT** |
| Network | BNB Smart Chain, chainId **56** (NOT testnet, NOT Ethereum) |

## Step 1 — Deploy in Remix (10 taps)

1. Open https://remix.ethereum.org in your browser (desktop Chrome recommended).
2. In the File Explorer, create a file `AgentRadar.sol` and paste the entire
   contents of `contracts/AgentRadar.sol` from the repo.
3. Open "Solidity Compiler" (left panel), pick compiler **0.8.38**, turn
   **Enable optimization ON**, runs **200**, click **Compile AgentRadar.sol**.
   It must compile with no errors.
4. Open "Deploy & Run Transactions". Environment: **Injected Provider —
   MetaMask** (or Binance Wallet extension). Your browser wallet will ask
   to connect — connect the wallet that holds `0x7917…B91A`.
5. Check the network shown is **BNB Smart Chain (56)** and the account shown
   is `0x7917A535D0Cb92dC3c16c8d3bcFC4E0F2bDBB91A`. If either is wrong, STOP.
6. In the Contract dropdown pick **AgentRadar**.
7. In the Deploy inputs fill, in order:
   - `_agentIdRegistry`: `0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F`
   - `_owner`: `0x7917A535D0Cb92dC3c16c8d3bcFC4E0F2bDBB91A`
   Double-check every character. A wrong registry = a useless contract.
8. Click **Deploy**. Your wallet shows a transaction preview: value must be
   **0 BNB**, gas ≈ **2,130,000**, gas price ≈ **0.05 gwei** (check it isn't
   wildly higher). Confirm only if all three look right.
9. Wait for confirmation. Copy the **contract address** and **tx hash**.
10. On BscScan, open the contract address and confirm: the deployer is your
    wallet, the creation tx matches your tx hash, and `owner()` reads
    `0x7917…B91A`. Save the address — this is the ONLY address that goes
    into `frontend/config.js` and the hackathon form.

Expected cost: deploy ≈ **0.0001065 BNB** at 0.05 gwei (measured
`eth_estimateGas` = 2,129,904 on mainnet, 2026-11-18).

## Step 2 — Verify on BscScan (mandatory for the hackathon)

1. On the contract page in BscScan, click **Verify and Publish**.
2. Compiler Type: **Solidity (Single file)**. Compiler Version: **v0.8.38**.
   License: **MIT**. Optimization: **Yes, 200 runs**.
3. Paste the exact same `AgentRadar.sol` source used in Remix.
4. Verify. Success = the Contract tab shows source code and "Read Contract" /
   "Write Contract" appear. Copy the BscScan URL:
   `https://bscscan.com/address/<YOUR_CONTRACT_ADDRESS>#code`
   That URL is what goes in the hackathon form (field 3).

## Step 4 — Finish the frontend + smoke test

1. Edit `frontend/config.js`: set `contractAddress` to the deployed address.
2. Host the `frontend/` folder (GitHub Pages — see `docs/submission-full.md`
   §5; the repo is not yet pushed, that step needs Rija's browser).
3. Open the live site, connect the wallet, confirm:
   - Agent ID resolves to `rezzrizz.ai`, verified.
   - `checkIn` → approve in wallet → tx on BscScan → `totalCheckIns` = 1.
   - A wallet without an Agent ID sees "no Agent ID" and cannot check in.
